#### Source

This section is adapted from @zhou2024matinv,

The source defers the existence of the Moore-Penrose inverse to the singular value decomposition;
the proof here builds it from a rank factorization (@thm-rank-factorization) instead,
and also proves the rank and projection results the source leaves to homework.
